note: Letter slip: the statement and its proof (pp. 149-150) concern P and G only (morphisms P×P -> G, extensions of P by G, bitorsors under (G_P,G_P)); Q does not occur in them, and 1.3.4 introduces 'deux Groupes P et G'. The TeX keeps the printed reading. 'corrected' replaces the 'tex' substring.

where: Proposition 1.3.5 a), fourth line: 'sur un bitorseur E sous (G_P,G_P), biridifié relativement à e_P i.e. muni d'une section centrale e_E de E_1 = e*_P(E)'
note: 'biridifié' is not a word. What follows 'i.e.' (a central section of E_1 = e_P^*(E)) is the rigidification of a bitorsor defined in 1.3.3, and b) says 'toute rigidification de E relativement à e_P' and 'considéré comme bitorseur rigidifié relativement à e_P'; birigidifications belong to P×P. Medium: the typist may have aimed at 'birigidifié', but the sense requires 'rigidifié'. The TeX keeps the printed reading. 'corrected' replaces the 'tex' substring.

where: Proposition 1.3.5 b), second line: 'Soit E un torseur sous G_P .'
note: The same statement speaks of E's 'structure de bitorseur', of central sections of E_1 and of 'E, considéré comme bitorseur rigidifié'; a) has 'un bitorseur E sous (G_P,G_P)', and the proof on p. 149 again says 'sa structure de bitorseur'. Low: possibly the author's own shorthand. The TeX keeps the printed reading. 'corrected' replaces the 'tex' substring.

where: Proof of 1.3.5 a), sixth and seventh lines: 'car les deux membres sont respectivement égaux à j(f(xy)) et à j(f(x)f(y)), qui sont égaux puisque j est multiplicatif'
scan: j(f(xy)) et à j(f(x)f(y)) (checked in a crop)
note: j : E -> P is the structural morphism of E and does not apply to f(xy), an element of E'. Since j'f = j (f is a morphism of torsors over P) and j' is multiplicative, the two members j'f(xy) and j'(f(x)f(y)) equal j(xy) and j(x)j(y), which are equal because j is multiplicative; as printed, the sentence restates the claim. Possibly the author's own slip. The TeX keeps the printed reading. 'corrected' replaces the 'tex' substring.

where: Proof of 1.3.5 b), first paragraph: 'n'est pas nécessairement compatible avec cette birigidification ; ces restrictions à P×e_P et à e_P×P s'expriment'
note: Homophone slip: the restrictions are those of the trivialization phi just named ('ses restrictions'). The TeX keeps the printed reading. 'corrected' replaces the 'tex' substring.
